recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Revisit DiagnosticReport.code/report-codes only if FHIR-50603 or a successor issue reaches a final Applied/Published decision to refine the LOINC subset or add guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-32754 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking whether DiagnosticReport.code should continue to prefer all of LOINC. The final R6 resolution was to constrain http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/report-codes to active LOINC terms where Order/Observation is Order or Both and Class Type is 1 or 2.
initial_application: Jira comments record application to the build in commit 7a7b280. Git history confirms 7a7b280c31ae8192fbaef46e07aa491789aeaa4d added STATUS, ORDER_OBS, and CLASSTYPE filters to source/diagnosticreport/valueset-report-codes.xml, and blame shows those lines still come from that commit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists diagnosticreport as an active resource, and DiagnosticReport.code still binds to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/report-codes. The closest related core issue, FHIR-50603, is Triaged/Unresolved and later comments/minutes say further discussion is needed, so it is background rather than a final reversal of FHIR-32754. Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-32754 discussion changing the Jira/source conclusion.
